# Design Notes: Unveil (ColorLib Unbrew)

## Aesthetic & Fidelity Guidelines

- **Color Palette**: Rich violet/purple gradient hero (`from-[#553be6] to-[#a87ffa]`), energetic sky-blue accent (`#1fb6fc`), deep slate headings (`#2a3a60`), and soft light indigo/lavender section backgrounds (`#eaedff`, `#f9faff`).
- **Section Order**:
  1. Navbar
  2. Hero (Boost Personal Productivity)
  3. Services (Marketing, SEO, UI/UX, Creative, Optimization, Strategy)
  4. About & Team (Adrian, Arthur, Anna, Brian)
  5. Testimonials & Counter
  6. Why Choose Us (Easy Management)
  7. Awesome Work (Portfolio Gallery)
  8. Pricing Plans
  9. Recent Blog
  10. Newsletter
  11. Footer (with mandatory Component Dock link)
- **Imagery**: All images use deterministic `https://picsum.photos/seed/unveil-<section>-<n>/<w>/<h>` URLs.
- **Typography**: Clean `Roboto` sans-serif font applied globally.
